Ten tracks, one record. Does it sound like one? 💿

Album mastering at Polished is €629 for up to 10 tracks. As 10 singles you'd pay €790, so you keep €161 in the band fund.

I audit every track on its own, then I audit the whole album once more. That's how track one and track ten end up with the same loudness and the same tonal balance.

Pressing vinyl? Ask me for a vinyl-ready master. Revisions are unlimited, and you'll have the album back in 7 to 14 days.

All prices incl. 19% VAT.

Mastering is not a gut feeling. It is applied audio engineering. ✍️

Every track gets treated like a research subject. Before deciding on an EQ move, a compression ratio or a saturation stage, it gets measured, compared and analysed.

That is not academic. It is efficient.

Targeted moves instead of plugin roulette. A background in Systematic Musicology at the University of Hamburg is not a line on a website here — it is the working method.

The result: fewer revisions needed, and a reason behind every decision when you ask.
